decisions.reason: As a very recent launch that builds on an existing offer, management would likely continue the superfood drink mix because development costs are already sunk and any weak early traction can still be framed as temporary market-building.

Management would keep the modular waste-to-energy plant extensions because they fit the firm's core sustainable engineering direction, likely required meaningful technical investment, and support the publicly stated expansion of deployable solutions.

Management would keep the waste oil to energy plant because it is strongly aligned with the firm's core business and was given especially visible public commitment through its own webpage, which encourages persistence.

Management would keep the plastic waste to fuel plant because it is close to the established offer, central to the firm's waste-to-value positioning, and early commercialization setbacks can be attributed to temporary adoption or scaling issues.
